Dagsion Armorer: 2 [[item:Bronze Axe]]s, a [[item:Wooden Spear]] and an [[item:Iron Axe]]
detail: Bronze Axes (500G): Buccar and Jasmine (+4). Wooden Spear (300G): Catania (+5).

note.text: Blacksmith opens (Renown 4): refine the ladder weapons on Smithing Stone first, deployed units first
detail: Guzran [[item:Wooden Sword +5]], Mu [[item:Wooden Gauntlets +5]], Leda [[item:Wooden Bow +5]], Catania's Wooden Spear.
Then Buccar's and Jasmine's [[item:Bronze Axe +4]]; Dadao's [[item:Iron Axe +3]] the day he joins.
+1 costs 2 Smithing Stone + 180G; higher steps ?. The Ledger's refine plan lists every weapon.

note.text: Blacksmith, rare ores: Leda's [[item:Lakshashi's Iron Fan +2]], then Buccar's [[item:Halberd +2]]
detail: Ores short? The Halberd waits for Ch 7; Guzran's Killing Edge +2 follows it.
Which rare ore each special takes is unknown: bank Cullet, Windstone and Blue Snoll.

assign.why: Dione Fort copy: mage-map swap for his shield

recruits.action: Pay 500G once Support 2 and Renown 4 land: bench Armored Knight trainee for Part II
detail: She joins at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class: Armored Knight at Lv 20 (Ch 7) from the Heavy seat.
EXP: put her in every Ch 6 to 8 dungeon party (5 seats); link attacks with Buccar raise their Support too.
Buccar missing before Ch 9? She deploys in his slot 3 from her recruit.

recruits.action: Hand over 2× [[gather:Kothar Gar]] once Support 2 and Renown 5 land: fishing only
recruits.when: Late Ch 6; early Ch 7 if Renown 5 slips
detail: [[place:Zeet Lake]] (Thaleia, via Aragona Posthouse) or [[place:Kothar Lake]] (Amalthea, via East Amalthea Posthouse).
He joins at about Lv 15 and takes slot 8 from his first map: the Hammer for the armored Ch 7 map.
When those lakes open on this route is unknown: fish the Gar as soon as one does.

prep.text: Fianna opens at Renown 5 (late Ch 6): recruit her in Ch 7 week 1 once Support 3 lands
detail: Keep 3,000G for her: pay it before the Ch 7 Mons Silver Shields.

prep.text: Io: recruit him on 9/28 for the Levin Sword he carries (filler)

explore.text: Every dungeon from her recruit: Jasmine in the 5-unit party, kills fed to her for Lv 20 in Ch 7
detail: The other four: Leda plus this week's meal pairs, so link attacks raise Support as well.

detail: [[item:Veroquine]] is cursed (Curse 2): hold it to the end of Part I (Drifting Reliquary).

explore.text: [[place:Dione Fort]] (Lv 18): Flying Manual (Catania), Hexlock Shield (Buccar), Dual Fish Knives
detail: Also a Concoction. The Hexlock is his Res +5 swap for the Silver Shield on mage maps.

explore.text: [[place:Valhalla Mine]] (Lv 20, Saveilon): [[item:Azaga's Bow]], Large Bullion, Antitoxin

detail: It may stay locked on this path until Dietrich's Paralogue in Ch 11.

detail: Cullet: [[place:Shadowy Cave]] if it is open, else [[place:Aditi's Cave]] in Ch 9.
Re-enter a cleared dungeon to reroll its crystals.
